type Boxes<T> = { [K in keyof T]: { value: T[K] } };
type RequiredBoxes<T> = { [K in keyof T]-?: { value: T[K] } };
function unbox<T>(input: Boxes<T>): T { return {} as T; }
function required<T>(input: RequiredBoxes<T>): T { return {} as T; }
const source: { value?: { value: string } } = { value: { value: 'hello' } };
const result = unbox(source);
const fromOrdinary: { value?: string } = {};
const badShape: typeof result = fromOrdinary;
const explicit: typeof result = { value: undefined };
const indexed: typeof result['value'] = undefined;
result.value = undefined;
delete result.value;
const maybeSource: { value?: { value: string | undefined } } = { value: { value: undefined } };
const maybe = unbox(maybeSource);
console.log(maybe.value.toUpperCase());
const forced = required(source);
console.log(forced.value.toUpperCase());
type Copy<T> = { [P in keyof T]: T[P] };
function copy<T>(value: Copy<T>): T { return value as T; }
const copied = copy(fromOrdinary);
const allowed: typeof copied = { value: undefined };
const mustBePresent: string = copied.value;
type OptionalBoxes<T> = { [P in keyof T]?: { value: T[P] } };
function optionalBoxes<T>(value: OptionalBoxes<T>): T { return {} as T; }
const nestedUndefined: { count?: { value: number | undefined } } = { count: { value: undefined } };
const completed = optionalBoxes(nestedUndefined);
const nestedValue: number = completed.count;
